exposure: Multi-disciplinary management (cesarean section, subtotal hysterectomy, bilateral internal iliac artery ligation, methotrexate therapy, surgical correction for incontinence)
outcome: Delivery of a healthy baby girl
cohort: A 29-year-old gravida 3, para 2 woman with suspected major placenta previa accreta, later diagnosed as placenta percreta with bladder invasion.
finding: Appropriate multi-disciplinary management of placenta percreta with bladder invasion can lead to a better outcome and complete recovery, despite potential complications like urinary incontinence.
mod_finding: Delivery was achieved by cesarean section as part of the management for placenta percreta.
